criterion: Grocery-store cooking materials, including defined retail mixtures. Keep meaningful fresh/dried, cube/granule/paste, grain/starch/nixtamalized/precooked, sodium and spirit/liqueur/style distinctions. Reuse published identities before adding a new one. Retail names support suggestions, not automatic recipe assignment, nutrition equivalence or inferred substitution.

research.basis: User-requested grocery-store follow-up to the second sample, including named product-family gaps beyond that sample.
research.note: The frozen 1,000-recipe studies and their source ambiguity decisions are not rewritten. Evidence is of grocery material availability; no complete store inventory or new population coverage estimate is claimed.

additions.label: dried angel hair pasta
additions.description: Shelf-stable dried fine-strand wheat pasta sold as angel hair or capellini. Distinct from fresh angel hair pasta in hydration and cooking time.

additions.label: chicken bouillon paste
additions.description: Moist concentrated chicken-based paste for making stock or flavoring recipes. Distinct from dry bouillon granules, cubes and prepared liquid stock; fat and sodium levels are unspecified.

additions.label: vegetable bouillon cube

coleslaw mix.note: Raw undressed shredded vegetable mixture based on cabbage, commonly with carrots, sold for preparing coleslaw or cooking. Distinct from coleslaw dressing and a finished dressed salad; exact proportions are unspecified.

frozen peppers and onions.note: Frozen mixture of cut sweet bell peppers and onions sold for cooking, without an added sauce. Pepper colors and vegetable proportions are unspecified; distinct from a single frozen vegetable or a sauced meal.

frozen stir-fry vegetables.note: Unsauced frozen mixed vegetables sold for stir-frying, commonly combining vegetables such as broccoli, carrot, peppers and peas. Exact mixture is unspecified; distinct from a sauced stir-fry kit or finished dish.

instant espresso powder.note: Dry soluble espresso-style coffee concentrate for baking or reconstitution. Distinct from ground roasted espresso beans and already brewed espresso.

harissa spice blend.note: Dry North African-style chili and spice blend sold as harissa seasoning. Exact formula and salt level are unspecified; distinct from moist harissa paste and plain ground chili.

salt-free seasoning blend.note: Mixed herbs, spices or vegetables sold as a salt-free general-purpose cooking seasoning. Exact blend is unspecified; distinct from seasoned salt, salt substitutes and specifically named barbecue blends. No nutrient values are inferred.

whole-grain dijon mustard.note: Prepared Dijon-style mustard retaining visible whole or partly crushed mustard seeds. Distinct from smooth Dijon mustard and grainy mustard without a specified Dijon style.

sweet italian sausage.note: Fresh uncooked Italian-style pork sausage sold as sweet Italian, with aromatic seasoning and without the hot-chili profile of hot Italian sausage. Casing or loose form is unspecified; distinct from cured salami and generic Italian sausage.

hot italian sausage.note: Fresh uncooked Italian-style pork sausage with a hot-chili seasoning profile. Casing or loose form is unspecified; distinct from sweet Italian sausage and cured Italian salami.

spring mix.note: Raw tender baby-leaf salad mixture sold as spring mix, combining young lettuces and other leafy greens without dressing. Exact leaves vary; distinct from a single lettuce, a mature cooking-greens mixture and a dressed salad kit.
